title: Add scorecard demo subcommand
description: Add a scorecard demo command that renders a feature-complete demonstration scorecard above the configured/user scorecard, covering criteria, links, grouping, charts, summaries, and terminal fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: scorecard demo renders the demonstration first and the normal scorecard second; demo covers all supported presentation features; behavior has regression tests and README/primer documentation; format, clippy, tests, install, and smoke checks pass.
notes: Implemented built-in examples/demo.md and scorecard demo [file]. Demo renders first in all mode through the production parser/renderers; default status file is optional, explicit file errors, selected card retains fit/actions/refresh. Documented in README, primer, and QOL log. Verified cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, 35 tests, installed text stack ordering, demo-only missing-default behavior, explicit missing-file error, and three forced iTerm image payloads.
close_reason: Implemented, documented, installed, and verified the feature-complete demo stack.

title: Render scorecard data tables as terminal charts
description: Allow an agent to serialize small data tables in scorecard markdown and have scorecard render them as sparklines, histograms, or time-series charts. Use iTerm2 inline images when supported and retain a useful text rendering elsewhere.
design: Parse dedicated Chart sections into a typed chart model. Treat Markdown only as serialization. Render deterministic dependency-free PNGs and emit the documented iTerm2 OSC 1337 inline-file protocol in image mode; use Unicode chart rows as the portable fallback. Keep chart selection explicit and bounded, account for visual height in fit behavior, and never query the terminal interactively during shell startup.
acceptance_criteria: Chart tables parse into typed labels and numeric series; sparkline, histogram, and time-series styles render; iTerm2 auto mode emits a valid inline PNG sequence; non-iTerm and redirected output use readable Unicode fallback; malformed/non-numeric data fails locally without breaking the scorecard; chart output remains bounded to one pane; CLI/docs/agent primer describe authoring and override controls; tests cover parsing, normalization, PNG validity, fallback rendering, and terminal mode selection.
close_reason: Implemented typed chart tables with sparkline, histogram, and time-series rendering, iTerm2 inline PNG output, Unicode fallback, pane-aware priority, tests, docs, and installed verification.

title: Auto-prune terminal tracker links from scorecard
description: Scorecard rows can remain stale after their linked Linear issues or GitHub pull requests reach a terminal state. Add a passive refresh path that discovers tracker links in criterion rows and removes an exact row only when every recognized tracker link on that row is conclusively terminal.
design: Keep normal rendering non-blocking by scheduling a detached, throttled refresh. Batch GitHub GraphQL lookups through gh and Linear GraphQL lookups through curl. Treat merged/closed GitHub PRs and completed/canceled Linear issues as terminal. Fail open on missing credentials, missing tools, malformed responses, or provider errors. Protect concurrent edits by pruning only source lines that still exactly match the snapshot. Never invoke group-aware action removal for automatic refresh.
acceptance_criteria: Normal scorecard render remains immediate; stale background refresh is at most hourly by default; explicit scorecard refresh is available; rows with one terminal tracker link are removed; multi-link rows are removed only when all recognized links are terminal; open or unknown states retain rows; exact-row pruning preserves sibling rows sharing topic groups; tests cover URL parsing, terminal semantics, multi-link safety, failures, and exact pruning; README and agent primer document behavior and authentication.
notes: Representation correction: tracker refresh reparses the live markdown into typed criterion/link nodes and applies terminal states to those nodes. Row formatting and note edits do not participate in identity; Markdown remains serialization. Automatic pruning still preserves shared-group siblings and fails open.
close_reason: Implemented structural GitHub/Linear reconciliation with hourly detached scheduling, conservative multi-link semantics, exact logical row pruning, tests, docs, and installed verification.

title: Track Codex global communication guidance
description: Add a dotfiles-owned Codex user-policy source and installer wiring so dense status output and per-mention PR-link rules survive OMX refreshes without tracking Codex runtime state.
acceptance_criteria: The policy is version-controlled, install.sh applies it idempotently to ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, OMX user-policy markers preserve it across setup refreshes, and the installed guidance is verified.
close_reason: Tracked the Codex communication policy, wired an idempotent OMX-preserving installer, installed it live, and verified syntax, backup, idempotence, and OMX contract recognition.

title: Align scorecard criterion columns
description: Criterion rows do not reserve a fixed width for IDs or scores, so state, score, and justification text shift horizontally when IDs or scores have different lengths. Add regression coverage and render these as stable columns across terminal widths.
acceptance_criteria: Rows with mixed-length IDs and scores align the state, score, and justification columns; rendered lines remain within the requested width; the installed scorecard reproduces the corrected layout.
close_reason: Fixed stable ID and score column widths, added alignment regression coverage, passed tests/build, and verified the installed renderer against the reported card.
